model_summaries.title: Route-preserving Blocker Band Disentanglement
model_summaries.boundary: Phase913 uses mild subunit interventions on L0 attention heads/spans and L4 MLP channel groups. A positive source candidate must lower the blocker band while preserving or increasing EOS logit; full component zeroing is not used as closure evidence.
